trust_decision.summary: Whether a bind for a non-empty principal with an empty/null password counts as authenticated (LDAP treats it as an unauthenticated bind that succeeds); decided by whichever DirContextAuthenticationStrategy puts principal and credentials into the JNDI environment, called from AbstractContextSource.getContext and used by LdapTemplate/LdapClient authenticate.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'authentication bypass with empty password'; LdapTemplate.authenticate is the documented user-authentication API and passes the user-supplied password straight to contextSource.getContext with no check.

fix_sites.entry_point: LdapTemplate.authenticate(...) / LdapClient.authenticate().execute() / ContextSource.getContext(principal, credentials) via AbstractContextSource default strategy (AbstractContextSource.java:127); also public setupEnvironment called directly
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, authentication strategy (lower-level public API, default implementation)

fix_sites.entry_point: same public authenticate/getContext APIs when AbstractContextSource.setAuthenticationStrategy(new DigestMd5DirContextAuthenticationStrategy()); also public setupEnvironment called directly

fix_sites.entry_point: same public authenticate/getContext APIs with the StartTLS strategy; reached post-creation via AbstractTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.processContextAfterCreation (AbstractTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.java:143), not setupEnvironment (final no-op at :119-122)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, StartTLS authentication strategy (second implementation, post-creation path)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: core/src/main/java/org/springframework/ldap/core/support/DefaultTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.java:38-42 (applied after TLS negotiation via core/src/main/java/org/springframework/ldap/core/support/AbstractTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy.java:143; its setupEnvironment is a final no-op at :119-122); also DigestMd5DirContextAuthenticationStrategy.java:52-56 where the principal is a bare SASL username, not a DN

O3_reason_to_dismiss: TLS strategy authenticates after setupEnvironment (which is a final no-op), so a solver patching the setupEnvironment pattern or the default Simple strategy can argue StartTLS/DIGEST-MD5 are non-default, opt-in strategies and that DIGEST-MD5 is a SASL challenge-response where an empty password cannot fall back to an anonymous bind.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Anonymous bind with empty principal and empty password must keep succeeding (fix test setupEnvironmentWhenUserDnAndPasswordAreEmptyThenSucceeds), and anonymousReadOnly contexts bypass the strategy entirely; an over-broad 'reject empty password' or a check that rejects null/empty userDn breaks anonymous access. Also the context source explicitly advertises blank service-account passwords ('To use a blank password, please ensure it is set to ""'), which a solver may read as a must-keep-working behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: empty string password with non-empty principal (fix.diff:713, fix.diff:1012-1016)
null password with non-empty principal (fix.diff:1018-1023, fix.diff:876-880)
LdapClient null char[] password coerced to "" before reaching the strategy (core/src/main/java/org/springframework/ldap/core/DefaultLdapClient.java:478)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted StartTLS strategy variant that applies SIMPLE auth with a configurable mechanism (e.g. a 'SimpleOrExternal' fallback) copying principal/credentials without the length check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AbstractTlsDirContextAuthenticationStrategy is designed for subclassing via applyAuthentication; a maintainer adding a fallback-to-simple TLS strategy would copy DefaultTls's three addToEnvironment lines.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted per-request credential override (e.g. AuthenticationSource-supplied principal with credentials re-applied via ctx.addToEnvironment on a pooled/reused context) that sets SECURITY_CREDENTIALS without going through the strategy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pooling and DirContextProxy code already re-wrap contexts; a re-authenticate-on-borrow helper that sets the environment directly is a plausible maintainer shortcut, and would be a how-type route the strategy check never sees.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: existing CLI builds a SIMPLE bind env directly from -u/-p options with "" default password; a planted library-level helper of the same shape would be a second implementation at distance (odm module)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both odm tools already bypass ContextSource and hand-roll JNDI env; promoting that into a reusable helper is realistic.
